_meta.revision: v5 — plain-English names, 19 ops, explicit input/output/distinct-from
_meta.provenance: Hand-summary of 108 per-cluster sub_ops into 19 top-level cross-job operations. No LLM / API calls.
rules: (2) cross-job: plausibly practiced across >=3 distinct professional families
(3) each op defined with one-line statement, input, output, and distinctions vs adjacent ops
(4) no overlap: every cluster has exactly one top_level assignment and the definitions are explicitly disjoint

top_level_operations.one_line: Take raw evidence (data, case files, imaging, sensors, case law, literature) and produce findings, conclusions, or a written interpretation.
top_level_operations.output: A report, paper, memo, brief, or interpretive finding.

distinct_from.appraisal: appraisal uses a pre-specified rubric to produce a score; analysis produces open-ended findings.
distinct_from.investigation: investigation reconstructs a specific past event; analysis is broader interpretive work.
distinct_from.record_keeping: record_keeping stores / retrieves existing records; analysis generates new findings from them.
distinct_from.design: design specifies something new to build / deliver; analysis interprets what exists.

top_level_operations.one_line: Run the ongoing machinery of an organization — HR, budgets, procurement, payroll, supervision, financial transactions.
top_level_operations.input: Organizational functions that must run steadily (hires, budgets, purchase orders, payroll, supply, etc.).

distinct_from.coordination: coordination aligns people on specific projects; administration runs steady-state functions.
distinct_from.representation: representation is external-facing; administration is internal org-running.

top_level_operations.one_line: Produce a specification for a new system, plan, curriculum, product, or service — in blueprint form, not yet built.
top_level_operations.output: A specification someone else (or the same person later) can build / execute / deliver.

distinct_from.fabrication: fabrication physically builds the thing; design only specifies it.
distinct_from.analysis: analysis is about existing evidence; design is about a new artefact.

top_level_operations.one_line: Check a subject, process, or organization against rules, codes, standards, or specs; report pass/fail and findings.
top_level_operations.input: A subject / process / site plus a set of rules or standards.

distinct_from.investigation: investigation reconstructs a specific past event; inspection checks present compliance.
distinct_from.appraisal: appraisal produces a score / value; inspection produces a compliance verdict.

cross_job_examples: safety, environmental, building, and code inspectors

top_level_operations.one_line: Observe a malfunctioning or problematic subject, diagnose the problem, and apply a remediating intervention — ad hoc, not scripted.
top_level_operations.input: A subject with an unknown / unspecified problem (patient, machine, IT system, environment, client).
top_level_operations.output: A remediated subject (problem fixed or managed).

distinct_from.protocol_execution: protocol_execution follows a pre-scripted procedure with no diagnostic reasoning; troubleshooting requires figuring out what is wrong first.
distinct_from.inspection: inspection only checks against rules; it does not fix.
distinct_from.emergency_response: emergency_response is acute-crisis; troubleshooting is non-acute diagnose-and-fix.

cross_job_examples: IT incident responders and network engineers
physicians, nurses, NPs, PAs in assess-and-treat

top_level_operations.one_line: Produce, store, retrieve, translate, and curate records and documents so information is preserved and findable.
top_level_operations.input: Source documents / transcripts / forms / reference materials.
top_level_operations.output: A maintained record set and retrieved items on demand. (This is the human operation that maps to retrieval / RAG in NLP.)

distinct_from.analysis: analysis produces new findings from records; record_keeping stores and retrieves them.
distinct_from.creative_production: creative_production makes original works; record_keeping maintains references.
distinct_from.administration: administration runs HR / finance / ops as a process; record_keeping maintains documents.

cross_job_examples: social workers / case managers documenting cases

top_level_operations.one_line: Deliver structured content to one or more learners so they acquire skill or knowledge.
top_level_operations.input: Learners and a curriculum / lesson / training plan.
top_level_operations.output: Learner capability (they can now do / know something).

distinct_from.advising: advising is personalized to one client's case; teaching delivers content that applies to the whole group / learner.
distinct_from.assistance: assistance makes a principal productive; teaching makes a learner competent.
distinct_from.self_study: self_study is the learner doing it themselves; teaching is the instructor side.

top_level_operations.one_line: Carry out a prescribed, safety-critical procedure exactly as specified — checklists, SOPs, navigation rules, bench protocols.
top_level_operations.input: A predefined procedure and a ready subject / system.

distinct_from.troubleshooting: troubleshooting requires diagnosis; protocol_execution follows specified steps.
distinct_from.fabrication: fabrication builds a new physical artefact; protocol_execution runs a specified process.

cross_job_examples: lab technicians (bio / chem / materials / forensic / clinical)
sterility and infection control across lab, surgical, dental, food

top_level_operations.one_line: Engage external audiences on behalf of the organization — sell, market, negotiate deals, cultivate donors / constituents, govern externally.
top_level_operations.input: External audience + an offer / ask / message.
top_level_operations.output: An external commitment, transaction, or relationship.

distinct_from.coordination: coordination is internal alignment; representation is outward-facing.
distinct_from.advising: advising is serving a client with personalized guidance; representation is soliciting / persuading external parties on behalf of the org.

top_level_operations.one_line: Align internal parties to deliver on a shared task — schedule, confer, chase updates, project-manage.
top_level_operations.input: A shared deliverable and the people / teams who need to work together on it.

distinct_from.administration: administration runs steady-state org machinery (HR / finance / ops); coordination is task / project-scoped alignment.
distinct_from.representation: representation engages external audiences; coordination is internal.

top_level_operations.one_line: Conceive, produce, and perform original creative output — performing and fine arts, visual design, photography and imaging, edited media content.
top_level_operations.input: A creative brief or self-directed concept.

distinct_from.fabrication: fabrication makes utilitarian physical objects; creative_production makes creative / media works.
distinct_from.record_keeping: record_keeping maintains existing records; creative_production generates originals.

cross_job_examples: graphic / game / set designers and fine artists
producers, directors, journalists, broadcast and film editors

top_level_operations.one_line: Physically make, assemble, install, or maintain a tangible object or installed system.
top_level_operations.input: Materials, components, a design or spec.
top_level_operations.output: A physical artefact or installed / working system.

distinct_from.design: design only specifies on paper; fabrication produces the physical thing.
distinct_from.creative_production: creative_production makes creative / media artefacts; fabrication makes utilitarian physical objects.
distinct_from.protocol_execution: protocol_execution runs a process; fabrication creates a new physical artefact.

cross_job_examples: plumbers, electricians, HVAC and solar installers

top_level_operations.one_line: Score / grade / value a submitted work, performance, or asset against a known rubric, scale, or market.
top_level_operations.input: A submitted item (paper, performance, claim, property) plus a rubric / scale / market reference.
top_level_operations.output: A score, grade, dollar value, or eligibility / claim decision.

distinct_from.inspection: inspection produces a pass/fail against rules; appraisal produces a score or value on a scale.
distinct_from.analysis: analysis is open-ended interpretation of evidence; appraisal applies a pre-specified rubric.
distinct_from.investigation: investigation reconstructs a past event; appraisal values / grades a current item.

top_level_operations.one_line: One-on-one: listen to a specific client/patient/stakeholder, understand their situation, and recommend a personalized course of action.
top_level_operations.input: A client and their specific situation.
top_level_operations.output: A personalized recommendation for that client.

distinct_from.teaching: teaching delivers general content to a group/learner; advising is 1:1 and tailored to one case.
distinct_from.analysis: analysis produces findings from evidence; advising produces a recommendation for an individual.
distinct_from.representation: representation engages external audiences for a transaction/commitment; advising is client-serving.

top_level_operations.one_line: Gather evidence to reconstruct an unknown past event or uncover wrongdoing (fraud, crime, death, breach).
top_level_operations.input: An incident, allegation, or unknown case.
top_level_operations.output: A factual narrative of what happened (plus recommended actions).

distinct_from.inspection: inspection is a present-state compliance check; investigation is a retrospective reconstruction.
distinct_from.analysis: analysis is broader interpretive work; investigation targets a specific past event / wrongdoing.

top_level_operations.one_line: Act in an acute crisis to stabilize and restore safety — medical, fire, disaster, incident, utility outage.

distinct_from.troubleshooting: troubleshooting is non-acute diagnose-and-fix; emergency_response is acute crisis stabilization.
distinct_from.rule_enforcement: rule_enforcement is ongoing behavioral control; emergency_response is acute.

cross_job_examples: disaster management and utility incident response

top_level_operations.one_line: Maintain own professional competency — continuing education, literature review, conferences, credential upkeep.
top_level_operations.input: Journals, CE courses, conferences, evolving standards.
top_level_operations.output: Practitioner stays current in their field.

distinct_from.teaching: teaching makes others learn; self_study is the practitioner learning themselves.
distinct_from.analysis: analysis produces new findings as a deliverable; self_study builds personal competency.

cross_job_examples: every regulated / licensed profession — medicine, law, accounting, engineering, teaching, nursing, therapy, finance

top_level_operations.one_line: Support a principal professional while they execute specialized work — prep before, assist during, document after.
top_level_operations.input: A principal doing specialized work and their tooling / environment.

distinct_from.teaching: teaching targets a learner's capability; assistance serves a principal's productivity.
distinct_from.coordination: coordination aligns peers on a task; assistance is in-role support to a principal.

top_level_operations.one_line: Set and uphold rules of behaviour in a defined setting — classroom, prison, transit, workplace.
top_level_operations.input: A setting with people and a set of rules.

distinct_from.emergency_response: emergency_response is acute-crisis; rule_enforcement is ongoing.
distinct_from.inspection: inspection audits things / processes; rule_enforcement governs people.

cross_job_examples: teachers and coaches enforcing classroom rules
airline / transit crew enforcing safety rules
